lines.text: Abijah became king of Judah and went to battle with 400,000 chosen men against Jeroboam's 800,000.
Abijah stood on Mount Carmel and told Israel the LORD gave the kingship to David and his descendants.
Abijah said Israel had golden calves and had driven out the priests, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites.
Jeroboam sent troops to ambush Judah from behind, and Judah cried out to the LORD as priests blew trumpets.
Five hundred thousand chosen men of Israel fell, and Abijah captured Bethel, Jeshanah, and Hebron from Jeroboam.
